item_short_desc: Rothco’s Lightweight Security Poncho is a practical and essential accessory for security personnel working in outdoor environments. Made from heat-sealed, water-resistant black vinyl, this poncho ensures you stay dry and protected in rainy or unpredictable weather. The bold "Security" print on both the front and back ensures clear visibility, making it easy for others to identify security staff. The poncho features snap closures to help secure your valuables and prevent water from entering.
description: Rothco’s Lightweight Security Poncho is a practical and essential accessory for security personnel working in outdoor environments. Made from heat-sealed, water-resistant black vinyl, this poncho ensures you stay dry and protected in rainy or unpredictable weather. The bold "Security" print on both the front and back ensures clear visibility, making it easy for others to identify security staff. The poncho features snap closures to help secure your valuables and prevent water from entering. At 50 inch x 80 inch, it offers generous coverage while remaining lightweight for easy wear. When not in use, simply store the poncho in its compact carrying pouch, making it an ideal on-the-go solution for security personnel. Whether working an event or patrolling outdoor areas, Rothco’s Lightweight Security Poncho provides the convenience, protection, and visibility you need.
